Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_051344.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_051344.v · Open raw
module origen_051344(
    input wire Uart_CLK,
    input wire [7:0] Data_Tx,
    input wire Wrsig,
    output reg Idle,
    output reg Signal_Tx
);

parameter paritymode = 0; // 0 for even parity, 1 for odd parity

reg [7:0] Tx_Data;
reg [7:0] Tx_Cnt;
reg parity;

always @(posedge Uart_CLK) begin
    if (Idle && Wrsig) begin
        Idle <= 0;
        Tx_Data <= Data_Tx;
        Tx_Cnt <= 0;
        parity <= paritymode;
    end else if (!Idle) begin
        case (Tx_Cnt)
            8'd0: begin
                Signal_Tx <= 0; // Start bit
                Tx_Cnt <= Tx_Cnt + 1;
            end
            8'd16, 8'd32, 8'd48, 8'd64, 8'd80, 8'd96, 8'd112, 8'd128: begin
                Signal_Tx <= Tx_Data[0];
                parity <= parity ^ Tx_Data[0];
                Tx_Data <= {1'b0, Tx_Data[7:1]};
                Tx_Cnt <= Tx_Cnt + 1;
            end
            8'd144: begin
                Signal_Tx <= parity; // Parity bit
                Tx_Cnt <= Tx_Cnt + 1;
            end
            8'd160: begin
                Signal_Tx <= 1; // Stop bit
                Tx_Cnt <= Tx_Cnt + 1;
            end
            8'd168: begin
                Idle <= 1;
                Signal_Tx <= 1;
                Tx_Cnt <= 0;
            end
            default: begin
                Tx_Cnt <= Tx_Cnt + 1;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
